flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4301/ then Do these steps in order.
Click the main menu button (three lines, top left). In the menu, under Canvas background, click the last colour square on the right (the one after the thin divider) so the colour picker opens. It has a Hex code text box.
Is this true right now: "a colour picker with a Hex code text box is open"? Store exactly yes or no as 'ready'.
Click into the Hex code text box, select everything in it, and type ff000080 (no # sign). Press Tab. Then wait 2 seconds. Do not click any colour square.
Then stop.
